items.title: Free Labyrinth Maze Stripe DXF Panel for Modern CNC Doors
items.description: Interlocking L-shaped stripes form a bold, maze-like geometric pattern across the full panel, with no central focal motif, just pure repeating structure. This strongly graphic, almost op-art design suits minimalist or industrial spaces where a striking abstract pattern is the goal.

items.title: Scattered Leaf Fragments SVG Panel for Organic Screens
items.description: Irregular leaf-shaped cutouts scatter freely across the surface without a fixed grid, giving an organic, hand-drawn feel. The random rhythm works well for garden gates, plant-inspired partitions, and screens that call for a softer, natural texture.
